sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Engapp sets the A1–C2 level of words with the open data below. A word in a list gets the list level; for a word that is clearly easier or harder for Turkish speakers it moves by at most one step. For words outside the lists, an AI estimate and the word's frequency in English decide.

cefrj.name: CEFR-J Wordlist 1.5
cefrj.what: About 7,800 words at levels A1–B2. © Tono Laboratory, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies (TUFS).
cefrj.license: Free for research and commercial use with citation.
cefrj.cite: The CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.5. Compiled by Yukio Tono, Tokyo University of Foreign Studies. Via Open Language Profiles.

octanove.name: Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 1.0
octanove.what: About 2,100 words at levels C1 and C2. © Octanove Labs.
octanove.cite: Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 (ver 1.0), Octanove Labs.

wordfreq.name: wordfreq 3.1.1
wordfreq.what: How often English words are used (Zipf scale). Robyn Speer; includes SUBTLEX data (Brysbaert et al.).
wordfreq.cite: Robyn Speer (2022). rspeer/wordfreq v3. Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7199437.

derived.name: Engapp level data
derived.what: Level files derived from these sources and the corrections for Turkish learners.

sources.aiBody: Levels of words outside the lists and the corrections for Turkish learners are made with Google Gemini. They are estimates: a correction moves a list level by at most one step, and an estimate is bounded by the word's frequency. You can always change a word's level yourself.

levelTest.title: Level test
levelTest.introTitle: Let's measure your level in 5 minutes
levelTest.introBody: You will see English words. For each one, say whether you know its meaning.
levelTest.introPoint1: Say “I know it” if you know the meaning, “I don't know” if you are not sure.
levelTest.introPoint2: Some words are made up. Say “I don't know” to them; that is how we see whether you are guessing.
levelTest.introPoint3: For some words you know, a four-choice meaning question follows.
levelTest.introPoint4: At most 70 questions. No internet needed.
levelTest.question: Do you know this word?
levelTest.keysWord: Keys: 1 I don't know · 2 I know it · Undo: Backspace
levelTest.loadFailed: The test could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
levelTest.saveFailed: The result could not be saved.
levelTest.nearNext: You are close to {{next}}: you know about {{pct}}% of the {{next}} words.
levelTest.towardNext: You know about {{pct}}% of the {{next}} words; {{next}} needs 80%.
levelTest.atTop: You are at the top level.
levelTest.markedKnown_one: {{count}} word you said you know was added to your known words; it will not be suggested as new.
levelTest.markedKnown_other: {{count}} words you said you know were added to your known words; they will not be suggested as new.
levelTest.unreliableTitle: This result does not look reliable

unreliable.guessing: You said “I know it” to {{pct}} of the made-up words. Saying “I don't know” when you are not sure gives the best result.
unreliable.meanings: You missed most meaning questions; you may not fully know some of the words you said you know.
unreliable.too_short: The test was too short to give a result.

levelTest.unreliableKept: Your level did not change ({{level}}). You can use the result anyway or take the test again.

level.offerBody: A short word test. Suggested words and your vocabulary counter adjust to the result.
level.offerDismissed: You can take the test any time from Settings → Level.
level.changeUp: For two weeks you have known about {{pct}}% of the {{band}} words (the week before: {{prev}}%). After two weeks in a row above 80% your level moves up one step.
level.changeDown: For two weeks you have known only about {{pct}}% of the {{band}} words (the week before: {{prev}}%). After two weeks in a row below 60% your level moves down one step.
level.changeEvidence: {{band}} words counted: {{known}} you know, {{unknown}} you struggled with (your cards, reviews, tests and words you marked as known).
level.changeRule: Your level changes at most one step a week. To stop automatic changes, lock it in Settings → Level.
level.ladderItem: {{level}}: you know about {{pct}}% of its words
level.explainBody: For each level of the word list (CEFR-J and Octanove), the number of words is multiplied by the estimated share you know, and the results are added up. The shares start from the level test and are updated by your cards, reviews and the words you marked as known.
level.explainOutside_one: {{count}} word you learned that is not in the list is added too.
level.explainOutside_other: {{count}} words you learned that are not in the list are added too.
level.explainNext: To reach {{next}} you need to know 80% of the {{next}} words; now {{pct}}%. Your level is updated weekly, after two weeks in a row above that line.
level.explainRounding: Numbers are rounded to tens; this is an estimate.
level.ctaTitle: How many words do you know?
level.ctaBody: Find out your level and estimated vocabulary with a 5-minute test.

knownWords.title: Words I know
knownWords.description: Words you said you know in the level test, in an import or by hand. They are not suggested as new words; a word you remove may be suggested again.
knownWords.empty: No words are marked as known yet.

family.title: Family
family.hint: Bold words are already in your cards. Tap any other word to add it.
family.suggest_one: The {{kind}} {{form}} appears in {{count}} of your words: {{words}}.
family.suggest_other: The {{kind}} {{form}} appears in {{count}} of your words: {{words}}.
family.suggestWhy: Learn its meaning once and these words, and new ones, get easier.
family.morphemeAddedBody: Recognition only: {{form}} on the front, its meaning and your words on the back.
family.noYourWords: None of your words has this {{kind}} yet.

falseFriend.label: False friend
falseFriend.reportedBody: We won't show this warning again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your interests decide which example-sentence context opens first.
profile.pickBody: Pick the topics you care about. Choose as many as you like and change them any time.
profile.weightsBody: Built from the topics you picked and the texts you imported. The longer the bar, the more the topic comes first.
profile.weightsEmpty: Nothing yet. Pick a topic or import a text and this fills up.
profile.mutedBody: A turned-off topic never comes first, even when you import texts about it.
profile.rule: Each topic you pick gets 3 points. Each text you import adds 1 point to its topic; a liked example sentence adds 0.5 and a skipped one takes away 0.25. Text and sentence points halve every 60 days, so the profile follows what interests you now. A turned-off topic is 0.
profile.ruleUse: The profile is calculated from data already on your device and in your account; it is not sent anywhere else.
profile.promptBody: Pick a few topics and example sentences will start with them. You can change them later in Settings → Profile.
profile.savedHint: Change them any time in Settings → Profile.

decks.title: Decks
decks.description: Your saved filters. Pick them above the Cards list and in practice rounds; they update as you add words.
decks.emptyBody: For example “Work · struggling”: words tagged work that you find hard.
decks.deleteBody: Only the deck is deleted; your words and tags stay as they are.

editor.name: Name
editor.statesHint: With several, any one is enough. Struggling: words you often forget or missed in the last two weeks.
editor.tagsNone: No tags yet. Select notes on the Cards screen and use “Tag”.
editor.levelsHint: The word level shown on the card (your own level first). With several, any one is enough.
editor.topicsHint: The topic of the text the word came from. With several, any one is enough.
editor.preview_one: {{count}} word is in this deck right now.
editor.preview_other: {{count}} words are in this deck right now.
editor.previewAll: Without conditions, all your words are in the deck.
editor.unsupported: This deck’s filter was made in a newer version of the app; here you can only rename it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.body: Tap a tag to see its words.
tags.empty: No tags yet. Select notes on the Cards screen and use the “Tag” button.
tags.renameHint: If a tag with this name exists, the two are merged. Decks using the tag are updated too.
tags.deleteBody_one: The tag is removed from {{count}} note. The note is not deleted.
tags.deleteBody_other: The tag is removed from {{count}} notes. The notes are not deleted.

themes.title: Group into themes
themes.body: AI groups your untagged words by topic. You preview first; approved group names become tags.
themes.pending: You have a preview waiting for approval.

themes.title: Group into themes
themes.description: AI groups your words by topic; you approve.
themes.includeTaggedHint: Existing tags stay; approved groups add a new tag.
themes.calls_one: Uses {{count}} call of your daily AI budget.
themes.calls_other: Uses {{count}} calls of your daily AI budget.
themes.privacy: Only the words and their short English dictionary definitions are sent. Your sentences, Turkish meanings and notes are not; the groups stay with you.
themes.signIn: Theme grouping uses AI and needs a Google sign-in.
themes.errorOffline: No internet connection. Try again when you are online.
themes.errorDaily: Your AI budget for today is used up. Try again tomorrow.
themes.errorBusy: The AI is very busy. Try again in a few minutes.
themes.errorPartial: Some words could not be grouped; the finished groups are below.
themes.summary_one: {{count}} theme suggested. Rename it, take words out or reject it.
themes.summary_other: {{count}} themes suggested. Rename them, take words out or reject a group.
themes.nameExisting: This tag exists; the words are added to it.
themes.nameRequired: The tag name cannot be empty.
themes.rejected: Rejected; no tag will be added.
themes.discardBody: The groups are not saved. Grouping again uses a new AI call.
themes.noGroups: The AI found no useful groups in these words. Try again after adding more words.
themes.saveFailed: Could not save the tags. Try again.
